name: Autonomous Investigation Loop
description: End-to-end autonomous pipeline: OSINT intake → investigation → ML training → reporting → repeat

architecture.diagram: OSINT Feed → Case Intake → Investigation Pipeline → ML Training → Report Generation → LLM Enrichment → Loop

components.name: Case Scanner
components.description: Scans reports/cases/ for cases with 'Pending Investigation' status and seed wallets

components.name: Investigation Runner
components.description: Creates cases/investigations via API, runs 6-step skill, classifies wallets

components.name: AutoML Engine
components.description: Automated model selection from 5-7 candidates with Optuna tuning

components.name: Report Generator
components.description: Generates structured markdown reports for LLM consumption

components.name: State Manager
components.description: Tracks processed cases, last training time, champion model
